name: Philippe Etancelin
features: ruddy skin, thinning fair hair, light eyes, weathered lined face, broad build, boisterous grinning expression
bio: A Rouen wool merchant who raced as an independent for thirty years, always in a flat cap worn back to front. 'Phi-Phi' won the 1930 French Grand Prix in a private Bugatti and the 1934 Le Mans 24 Hours with Luigi Chinetti, and was still starting Formula One races in 1952 at the age of 55.
